title: Horizon Glass
author: CMDR Snickerdoodlez
description: A bright, open sound pack: felt piano, glass bells, soft mallets and air in D mixolydian, with the C-to-D lift as its signature (on access granted, docking, promotions and the end of a route). Every one of the app's 30 sounds. Made to go with the Far Horizon random sounds; works with any theme.
